info.title: VMware VeloCloud SD-WAN Orchestrator
info.description: Authentication: static Orchestrator API token, replayed on every request via the Authorization header. VMware (Broadcom) VeloCloud SD-WAN Orchestrator (VCO) REST API for managing Customers, Edges, and profile/Edge configuration modules across an SD-WAN deployment. Base path is `/api/sdwan/v2`.
info.x-itential-curated: Trimmed to 26 of 72 upstream operations covering Customers (Enterprises), Edges, Edge/Profile deviceSettings and QoS configuration modules, Alerts, Events, and Client Devices -- the resources most SD-WAN day-2 automation actually touches. See the repo README for the full operation breakdown and the full spec.

apiToken.name: Authorization
apiToken.description: Static Orchestrator API token, provisioned in the VCO UI under user preferences. Full header value: `Token <api_token>`. Replaces the deprecated JSON login + session-cookie flow.

code.description: A short string that uniquely identifies the error.

message.description: A brief, user-friendly message elaborating on the error.

developerMessage.description: A technical error message intended to help the developer of the client.

errors.description: Detailed list of syntax validation errors, if any.

id.description: Legacy numeric enterpriseId, used by the Portal API.

created.description: Epoch timestamp the Customer was created.

siteLogicalId.description: logicalId of an existing Site to assign the Edge to.

profileLogicalId.description: logicalId of the Profile to assign the Edge to.

ModuleResource.description: A configuration module (e.g. deviceSettings, qos) attached to an Edge or Profile.

name.description: Module name, e.g. deviceSettings or QOS.

data.description: Module-specific configuration payload; structure varies by module name.
